entities.name: Sugi Hayashi
entities.description: A kitsune village of about 70 in the Jukai forest on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Pearl-Ear
entities.description: Kitsune of Sugi Hayashi who served Konda at Eiganjo.

entities.name: Sharp-Ear
entities.description: Pearl-Ear's brother, who guided Michiko with foxfire.

entities.name: Silk-Eyes
entities.description: Elder of the village whose magic showed a vision.

entities.name: Silver-Foot
entities.description: Captain who caught Riko and Choryu.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: The Princess who arrived at the village.

entities.name: Nagao
entities.description: Captain who demanded the Princess's return.

entities.name: Seitaro Yamazaki
entities.description: A bandit twin leading an akki warband.

entities.name: Shujiro Yamazaki
entities.description: A bandit twin leading an akki warband.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: The lord Pearl-Ear served at Eiganjo.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war during which these events happened.

events.summary: Pearl-Ear returns to her village seeking answers about the war's origin and meets Silk-Eyes.
events.quote: seeking answers to her questions regarding the origin of the war

events.summary: Michiko arrives guided by Sharp-Ear's foxfire, and Riko and Choryu are brought in by Silver-Foot.
events.quote: until Michiko Konda arrived guided by a foxfire light cast by Sharp-Ear

events.summary: Captain Nagao arrives demanding the Princess's return but must stay because of the akki threat.
events.quote: demanding the return of the Princess to her home

events.summary: A company rides out against the akki and is routed; Nagao and Sharp-Ear are wounded.
events.quote: Both Nagao and Sharp-Ear were wounded

events.summary: Michiko's party leaves for the lands of the orochi following Silk-Eyes' vision.
events.quote: it was decided that Michiko's party would leave Sugi Hayashi to go to the lands of the orochi

events.summary: The akki army razes Sugi Hayashi; the kitsune vow to rebuild.
events.quote: Sugi Hayashi was razed by the akki army, but the kitsune swore they would rebuild it.

relations.quote: Lady Pearl-Ear and her brother Sharp-Ear

relations.note: Years in his service at Eiganjo.
relations.quote: a few decades in the service of Takeshi Konda at Eiganjo
